start.title: Antes de todas las cosas
start.text:
Nada existe todavía.
Solo tú, y la profunda e infinita oscuridad.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You wait. The darkness presses closer — patient, heavy.
[TODO:es] Your hand stretches forward. Something stirs beneath the surface.
[TODO:es] A sound rises from deep within you — the first sound ever made.

silence.title: El Gran Silencio
silence.text:
Esperas en la quietud.
El vacío duele, necesita algo más.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The word gathers inside you — heavy with purpose.
[TODO:es] Your breath ripples across the deep. Something awakens.

voice.title: La Palabra
voice.text:
Tu voz desgarra la nada.
Lleva el peso de la eternidad.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The command explodes from you. There is no turning back.
[TODO:es] The whisper leaves your lips — soft, yet unstoppable.

void.title: La profundidad sin forma
void.text:
Aguas infinitas se extienden bajo ti.
Flotas sobre el abismo.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You lower yourself. The water trembles at your presence.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stir the surface with your breath
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your breath moves across the face of the deep.

light.title: Hágase la luz
light.text:
La luz brota de ti, cegadora, infinita.
El calor inunda el vacío por primera vez.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The light races outward — filling every void.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Shape the light — give it edges
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You cup the light in your hands. It pulses, alive.
[TODO:es] You draw a line between light and dark. Order begins.

light_obey.title: Hágase la luz
light_obey.text:
Tu mandato sacude el vacío.
La luz explota: infinita, cegadora, viva.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Warmth gathers around you — golden, tender.
[TODO:es] The light obeys. It floods the emptiness without end.

light_awe.title: Hágase la luz
light_awe.text:
La luz se eleva suavemente de tu aliento.
Suave al principio, luego deslumbrante, imparable.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You press the light upward — it stretches into sky.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Divide the light from the dark
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Shadow and radiance separate at your touch.

warmth.title: Primer calor
warmth.text:
La luz se convierte en calor.
Sientes que la creación responde a tu toque.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You reach upward. The sky begins to unfold.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Spread your hands — expand it all
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Everything stretches — wider, higher, limitless.

day_night.title: Tarde y mañana
day_night.text:
Llamas a la luz Día y a la oscuridad Noche.
El primer atardecer. El primer amanecer.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You move forward. There is more to create.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Pause — linger in what you've made
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You stop. The colors are yours — and they are beautiful.

sky.title: Los cielos arriba
sky.text:
Extiendes el cielo como una cortina.
Las aguas se separan, arriba y abajo.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Command the dry land to appear
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your voice strikes the deep. The earth begins to rise.
[TODO:es] The waters obey — drawing inward, making room.
[TODO:es] You pause. The sky stretches further than you imagined.

sky_vast.title: El vasto cielo
sky_vast.text:
El azul se extiende infinitamente en todas direcciones.
Tu creación crece más allá de lo que incluso tú imaginaste.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You speak downward. The ground trembles in answer.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Gather the seas into their places
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The waters rush to their boundaries — eager, wild.

waters_gather.title: La Reunión de las Aguas
waters_gather.text:
Empujas los océanos a sus lugares.
Los ríos abren caminos a tu mandato.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Raise the mountains from the deep
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Stone groans upward. The peaks reach toward you.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Shape the earth with your hands
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You kneel. The soil is warm beneath your fingers.

expanse.title: La Bóveda Celeste
expanse.text:
El cielo se arquea como una catedral que construiste.
Cada dirección encierra una promesa.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You look down. The earth rises to meet your gaze.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Press your hands into the earth
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your palms sink into the clay. It yields to you.

land.title: Tierra Seca
land.text:
Las montañas se alzan a tu palabra.
El verde brota — repentino, salvaje, por doquier.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Plant a forest with a thought
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Trees spring up — tall, ancient, reaching for your sky.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Craft the first flower by hand
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] A single bloom opens in your palm. Perfect.
[TODO:es] You ascend. The world unfolds beneath you.

land_emerge.title: La Tierra se Eleva
land_emerge.text:
La tierra firme se forma bajo tu toque.
Sientes la tierra respirar por primera vez.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Seeds fall from your hands like rain. Life begins.
[TODO:es] You watch it grow — slowly, tenderly, from nothing.

plants.title: El Primer Jardín
plants.text:
Los árboles se estiran hacia el cielo que creaste.
La fruta cuelga pesada — dulce, intacta.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Sweetness fills you — your own gift, tasted for the first time.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Wait for darkness — then fill it
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You wait. The empty sky calls to you.

flowers.title: Colores Sin Nombre
flowers.text:
Los pétalos se abren a tu toque.
Colores que ningún ojo ha visto jamás — hasta ahora.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The scent is unlike anything. Because nothing existed before.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Turn your gaze upward — the sky is empty
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The dark sky waits — a canvas, unfinished.

mountain.title: La Cima
mountain.text:
Desde la cima, ves todo lo que has hecho.
Un cielo vacío — esperando ser llenado.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You reach up. The first star burns in your hand.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Descend — there is more to do
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You climb down. The work is not yet finished.

stars.title: Sol, Luna y Estrellas
stars.text:
Cuelgas el sol como una lámpara.
Mil estrellas vuelan de tus dedos.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The ocean stretches before you — vast, silent, waiting.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Place every star one by one
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Each star finds its place. You name them all.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Set the moon in its place
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Silver rises. The night breathes softly.

stars_delight.title: Sol, Luna y Estrellas
stars_delight.text:
La dulzura perdura — tu creación es buena.
Sobre ti, el cielo espera la luz.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Fire leaps from your fingers. The sky blazes.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Paint the night sky with silver
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Moonlight pours down — gentle, steady, yours.

stars_vision.title: Sol, Luna y Estrellas
stars_vision.text:
Desde la cima de la montaña, lanzas estrellas a la oscuridad.
Cada una una promesa.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] More. More. The darkness shrinks with every throw.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Set the moon to guard the night
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The moon rises — faithful, watching over what you made.

countless_stars.title: Incontables
countless_stars.text:
Las colocas más allá de la cuenta.
Cada una un pacto — un susurro de lo que está por venir.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Below, the waters are still. They need life.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Rest a moment beneath your sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You lie back. Your stars shine above you.

moonrise.title: La Luz Menor
moonrise.text:
La luz plateada se derrama sobre las aguas quietas.
La luna toma su lugar — fiel, silenciosa.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You turn to the deep. It's time to fill it.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Wait for the dawn you designed
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You wait. The horizon glows with approaching light.

sea_dawn.title: Amanecer sobre el Abismo
sea_dawn.text:
Amanece — tu amanecer.
Las aguas se agitan, listas para recibir vida.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your voice enters the water. Movement begins.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Listen to the silence before it fills
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] One last breath of stillness. Then — everything.

sea_creatures.title: Las Aguas Pululan
sea_creatures.text:
Llenas los mares — ballenas, peces, enjambres de vida.
Las aves brotan de tus manos — llenando el cielo de canto.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Turn to the land — it's still empty
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The ground waits. You have more to give.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Send a bird soaring across the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Wings spread. The bird trusts the wind you made.

bird_flight.title: Primer Vuelo
bird_flight.text:
Las alas atrapan el viento que creaste.
El pájaro no conoce el miedo, solo el cielo.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Return to the ground — fill it next
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You descend. The earth needs creatures of its own.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Feel the wind on your face
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The breeze you made touches your skin. It's good.

land_creatures.title: Todo ser vivo
land_creatures.text:
Tú hablas, y aparecen leones, ciervos, serpientes, insectos.
La tierra respira con la vida que le diste.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Something is still missing — press on
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] A restlessness stirs in you. This isn't finished.
[TODO:es] They gather around you — warm, trusting, alive.

land_creatures_wind.title: Todo ser vivo
land_creatures_wind.text:
Estás entre criaturas: salvajes, cálidas, vivas.
No huyen. Conocen tu voz.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You sit. They press close — unafraid.
[TODO:es] The ache rises. None of them can truly know you.

among_animals.title: Entre las criaturas
among_animals.text:
Se reúnen a tu alrededor: confiadas, vivas.
Pero ninguna de ellas puede conocerte. No de verdad.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Feel the ache of being alone
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The loneliness deepens. You need someone who understands.
[TODO:es] You stand. Your hands know what to do.

before_man.title: El sexto día
before_man.text:
Te arrodillas en el polvo.
Tus manos empiezan a dar forma a algo nuevo, algo parecido a ti.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your fingers press into the dust. A form takes shape.
[TODO:es] The words leave your lips. The clay trembles.

before_man_lonely.title: El sexto día
before_man_lonely.text:
El anhelo se profundiza: quieres ser conocido.
Te arrodillas en el polvo y empiezas.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Shape the clay with trembling hands
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your hands shake. This one will be different.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Take your time — this matters most
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You slow down. Every detail matters.

breath_of_life.title: El aliento de vida
breath_of_life.text:
El polvo se convierte en carne bajo tus manos.
Te acercas y le insuflas vida.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His eyes open. He sees you first.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Place him gently in the garden
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You carry him — warm, breathing — into paradise.

breath_of_life_sacred.title: El aliento de vida
breath_of_life_sacred.text:
Tu aliento entra en la arcilla.
Su pecho se eleva. Su corazón late: una, dos veces, para siempre.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You lay him gently on the grass. He stirs.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stand back — let him see the world
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You step away. His eyes open to everything you made.

first_garden.title: Edén
first_garden.text:
El paraíso se extiende ante ti, tu obra maestra.
Miras todo lo que has hecho.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Say it — the words that complete it all
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The words rise in you — final, certain.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Sit beside your creation in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You sit. No words needed. It is enough.

first_garden_wonder.title: Edén
first_garden_wonder.text:
Él está en el jardín: vivo, respirando, tuyo.
Todo, absolutamente todo, fue para este momento.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your voice fills the garden — warm, full, complete.
[TODO:es] You exhale. It is done.

very_good.title: Muy bueno
very_good.text:
«Es muy bueno».
Sonríes ante tu obra.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Peace settles over everything.

rest.title: El séptimo día
rest.text:
Descansas. Toda la creación respira.
La historia no ha hecho más que empezar.

rest_blessed.title: El séptimo día
rest_blessed.text:
Descansas junto al que creaste.
La paz llena cada rincón de tu mundo.
